items.name: Har Gow
items.desc: Crystal shrimp dumplings with bamboo shoots and ginger. Four pieces per basket, steamed to a delicate translucence.

items.name: Siu Mai
items.desc: Open-top pork and shrimp dumplings crowned with crab roe. Juicy, savory, and best eaten in one bite.

items.name: Char Siu Bao
items.desc: Fluffy milk-bun pillows filled with sweet honey-glazed barbecue pork.

items.name: Liu Sha Bao
items.desc: Golden salted-egg-yolk custard buns that flow like lava when torn open.

items.name: Cheung Fun
items.desc: Silky rice noodle rolls filled with shrimp, doused in sweet soy sauce and sesame oil.

items.name: Spring Rolls
items.desc: Crispy golden rolls of shredded cabbage, mushrooms, and glass noodles.

items.name: Turnip Cake
items.desc: Pan-fried cubes of savory radish cake with Chinese sausage and dried shrimp.

items.name: Egg Tart
items.desc: Flaky puff pastry cradling a wobbly, caramelized egg custard.

items.name: Char Siu Pastry
items.desc: Buttery baked parcels filled with caramelized barbecue pork.

items.name: Beef Chow Fun
items.desc: Wok-charred flat rice noodles with sliced beef, bean sprouts, and scallions. The mark of a good kitchen is in the wok hei.

items.name: Wonton Noodle Soup
items.desc: Fine egg noodles in a clear dried-flounder broth with plump shrimp wontons.

items.name: Claypot Rice
items.desc: Crispy-bottomed rice with Chinese sausage, cured duck, and shiitake, finished with sweet soy.

items.name: Century Egg Congee
items.desc: Silky rice porridge with lean pork, preserved egg, and ginger scallion oil.

items.name: Char Siu
items.desc: Honey-glazed barbecued pork with charred edges and a molten maltose lacquer.

items.name: Roast Duck
items.desc: Crisp-skinned duck with five-spice aroma, served with plum sauce.

items.name: Crispy Pork Belly
items.desc: Crackling pork belly with tender meat and a side of mustard.

items.name: Poached Chicken
items.desc: Silky free-range chicken poached in ginger-scallion broth, served cold with dipping oil.

items.name: Steamed Whole Fish
items.desc: Daily catch steamed with ginger, scallion, and soy. Light, clean, and resolutely Cantonese.

items.name: Gai Lan with Oyster Sauce
items.desc: Blanched Chinese broccoli dressed in oyster sauce and garlic oil.

items.name: Salt & Pepper Squid
items.desc: Crispy squid tossed with salt, white pepper, garlic, and dried chili.

items.name: Lobster with Ginger & Scallion
items.desc: Whole lobster stir-fried with ginger, scallion, and Shaoxing wine.

items.name: Iron Goddess Oolong
items.desc: Floral, roasted Tieguanyin. The classic companion to dim sum.

items.name: Aged Pu-erh
items.desc: Earthy, dark tea that cuts through the richness of roast meats.

items.name: Hong Kong Milk Tea
items.desc: Strong Ceylon and evaporated milk, pulled through a silk stocking.

items.name: Lemon Iced Tea
items.desc: Chilled black tea with fresh lemon slices — sweet, tart, and refreshing.
